title: Tutorial-Specify Checkpoint
description: On-disk state file at specs/<NNN>-tutorial-chNN/.checkpoint.json. Written atomically (write-temp-then-rename) after every meaningful step. See plan.md Decision 4 and data-model.md > Checkpoint.

schema_version.description: Semver of this checkpoint schema. Bumped only when the schema changes incompatibly.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this checkpoint was first created.

last_updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this checkpoint was last written.

inputs.description: Map of input file path -> SHA-256 content-hash. Verified on --resume; mismatch -> abort per FR-019.

book_page_to_pdf_page.description: Map of book page number -> PDF page number. Built once per PDF content-hash per Decision 5.

tutorial_mode.description: Read from the **Mode**: header in chNN_plan.md per FR-007.

extracted_blocks.description: Code-bearing extractions from GLP_ART.pdf for this chapter.

program_id.description: e.g., 'Program 1.1' if the book labels it; null otherwise.

pdf_pages.description: Internal use only; never appears in spec output (FR-003).

completed_steps.description: Ordered list of step names that have completed successfully.

pending_steps.description: Ordered list of step names that have not yet started.

current_step.description: Name of the step currently in progress (or null if idle/terminated).

abort_reason.description: Set when terminated_with == 'aborted'; precise human-readable reason.
